dcterms:description: A multimodal dataset for in-car command recognition in the Cantonese language, consisting of both audio and video data. It includes 4,984 samples of 200 unique in-car commands recorded by 30 native Cantonese speakers, augmented with common in-car background noises to simulate real environments.
dcterms:title: Cantonese In-car Audio-Visual Speech Recognition (CI-AVSR)
